privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sec1P1: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account (Email), suggest radio programs, or heart a station.
privacy.sec1P2: We also automatically collect certain interaction data, including which stations you play or which shows you view, to power our community analytics (Trending and Popularity lists).
privacy.sec2P1:
- To provide, maintain, and improve our services.
- To aggregate anonymous community metrics (e.g., tracking "clicks" per show).
- To synchronize your favorites across your devices (for logged-in users).
- To communicate with you about updates to the platform.
privacy.sec3P1: We do not sell your personal data. We use Supabase for secure database management and authentication.
privacy.sec3P2: Please note that Rezoa streams content from external radio stations. Interacting with these streams may involve standard internet communication with third-party servers.
privacy.sec4P1: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time via your profile settings or by contacting our support.
privacy.sec5P1: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse, and unauthorized access.
